question: Which State Assembly passed the resolution on Sarna Code in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

__
 
• **Jharkhand State Assembly passed the resolution on Sarna Code in November 2020.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarna Code:**

 
 
• The code of provisions of separate law for the **Sarna tribal community.**
 
• It was passed by the **Jharkhand State Assembly.**
 
• It** empowers tribals **to **identify themselves as belonging to a distinct religious community.**
 
• ***Before the code, they were not classified as a separate religious category.***
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jharkhand State Assembly:**

 
 
• It is a** unicameral legislative assembly.**
 
• **Rabindra Nath Mahato** is the current **speaker**.
 
• **Hemant Soren** is the **Leader of the House and the Chief Ministe**r.
 
• **Babulal Marandi **is the** Leader of the Opposition.**
